display: The Circle Atlas — viewports, TO and FROM, sign-posts, gaps
descriptive: Runs every viewport through which the project's mathematics meets a circle. TO is the transformation that enters fixed-point space (and whether the result closes on |z| = 1); FROM is the transformation out, with the fibre of choices it needs (a relation, not an inverse). Each viewport names its π route. The census counts circle-bearing tokens across the repositories; the import probe records which modules do not load.
